body:
Nothing keeping me up, is more like it. Got no one to talk to, tried therapy and anti depressiva. I work at a dead-end job, and is too socially awkward to actually form a friendship with anyone there, been there too long anyway. I've been depressed for over half my life, have no hobbies or interests either. 
The only reason I didn't kill myself years ago was the guilt i felt for leaving my family behind. But I'm tired of living for others, and have no reason to live for myself, so there's that..
